settings.label: One-sentence story
settings.default: Maison Rivault makes quiet, well-made knitwear for men who want to look put-together without trying, built in layers you can wear from the first cold morning to the last.

settings.label: Location line
settings.info: Example: Phoenix, Arizona. Leave blank until confirmed; blank shows a [confirm] marker.

settings.content: Waitlist mode is Shopify's own storefront password (Online Store > Preferences > Restrict access). With the password on, visitors see only the waitlist page. Turn it off to open the store.

settings.label: Show prices and allow Add to cart
settings.info: Off: every product says Price at launch and Add to cart is disabled, even if a price is set in Shopify. Turn on once supplier quotes are final.

settings.content: Each product's availability mode comes from its custom.availability metafield. Empty fields below show a [confirm] marker on the site so nothing is invented.

settings.label: Made to order: estimated delivery window
Preorder charge policy
settings.info: State plainly when the customer is charged.

settings.label: Holiday order cutoff date
settings.info: Leave blank unless a date is confirmed.

settings.label: Cutoff date is confirmed
settings.info: Until a date is set and this is ticked, the site says it cannot promise delivery before December 25.
